items.title: Taco Bell sales rebounding after cyclosporiasis outbreak, CEO says
items.summary: Taco Bell's sales are recovering after a cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to lettuce served at some of its restaurants hurt business over the summer.

items.title: Yum! Brands (YUM) Unveils KFC Muse Flagship In Dubai
items.summary: Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) introduced KFC Muse, a new global flagship restaurant design, with an inaugural site in Dubai. The KFC Muse format debuts a fresh visual identity along with a more immersive in store environment for guests. The Dubai flagship showcases bespoke offerings, including the KWENCH beverage range and customizable KFC MIX'D meal options. A second KFC Muse location is planned for Seoul, signaling Yum! items.title: An entire island just lost its KFC and Taco Bell overnight
items.summary: Yum! Brands abruptly ended its relationship with the Puerto Rican operator of KFC and Taco Bell.

items.title: Taco Bell’s loyalty program helped the brand recover from Cyclospora outbreak
items.summary: Loyalty members returned to Taco Bell twice as quickly as non-loyalty customers following a foodborne illness scare this summer, parent company Yum Brands CEO Chris Turner said.

items.title: Yum Brands earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Yum! Brands (YUM) reported Q3 on Nov 3, 2026. Adjusted EPS of $1.56 beat the $1.53 consensus (+1.96%). Revenue of $2.05B missed the $2.10B estimate. Shares were at $157.05 (-0.35%) as of Nov 3, 12:51 PM EST. They had opened near $163 and given back the early pop. The stock is up 15.38% over one month and 12.68% over one year.
